title: Test code and implementation evidence
description: Read the test cases in test/blockchain.test.js, test/node.test.js, test/ws.test.js beside the implementation in src/blockchain.js. Explain the behavior asserted by the tests and trace each assertion to the implementation. A test file describes a check; it does not prove that check passed.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in test/blockchain.test.js, test/node.test.js, test/ws.test.js, src/blockchain.js.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

practical_outcomes: Evidence map for test/blockchain.test.js, test/node.test.js, test/ws.test.js, src/blockchain.js
completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
